item.text: The collector stops whenever the returned item count is below `pageSize`. Since the gateway filters deleted records before returning a page, the first page looks short even though it has a continuation cursor. I’ll make the cursor the scan’s end condition so later active records are collected.

Fixed pagination in [pager.ts](C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-catalog-pages-lying-1-ce7lod0z/ws/src/pager.ts): the collector now follows the gateway’s continuation cursor instead of stopping when filtering deleted records makes a page appear short. I didn’t run tests.
